2.1.1:
CppAssistant 2.1.1

- Menu localization now works: CppAssistant: Toggle Menu Language switches CppAssistant's own menu between English and Chinese.
- Template packs are bundled and install on demand; uninstalled packs stay hidden. Manage enable/disable from the same menu.
- Array bounds checking, template parameter deduction, diagnostic filters and CI fixes.
See CHANGELOG.md for details.
install:
Welcome to CppAssistant!

🚀 Quick Start:
1. Open a .cpp/.h file and start typing - semantic completions appear automatically
2. Press F12 to go to definition
3. Press Ctrl+Alt+F to format document (jiangly style)
4. Press Ctrl+. for code actions

📋 Key Commands:
- F12: Go to Definition
- Ctrl+Alt+F: Format Document
- Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F: Format Selection
- Ctrl+.: Code Actions
- Ctrl+Alt+R: Rename Symbol
- Shift+F12: Find References
- Ctrl+Alt+D: Show Diagnostics
- Ctrl+Alt+,: Fix Full-width Punctuation
- Command Palette: Browse Templates, Call/Type Hierarchy, Validate Settings

⚙️ Setup clangd (recommended):
- Windows (MSYS2): pacman -S mingw-w64-x86_64-clang
- Linux: sudo apt install clangd / sudo dnf install clang-tools-extra
- macOS: brew install llvm && echo 'export PATH="$(brew --prefix llvm)/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.zshrc

🔧 Configuration:
Preferences > Package Settings > CppAssistant > Settings

📖 Documentation:
- README.md - English
- README.zh-CN.md - 中文文档
- CHANGELOG.md - 更新日志

🏆 For OIers (竞赛选手):
- Graph, Geometry, DS, Strings and Math template packs
- jiangly code style formatting
- Millisecond bracket/punctuation checks
- bits/stdc++.h PCH acceleration
- Array bounds checking
- Template parameter deduction

💡 Tip: Set "display_language": "zh" for Chinese diagnostics
